creator: Alexander Terp
description: MIP-4 section 1 says any msg verb starts a daemon the way the app does (Launch Services on the Mac, setsid on Linux) when none is running. Stage 1 deferred it: the launch code lives in muster-daemon-client, which links libghostty-vt, and the CLI must not. It needs the launch code moved into a pure crate. Today a msg verb with no daemon exits 3 and says how to start one.
title: msg verbs start a daemon when none runs
